characters.name: Aria
characters.role: sky sanctum keeper with wings and a ring halo

characters.silhouette_class: wide wing bar under a thin ring halo

main_colour.name: halo gold

characters.name: Aurora
characters.age_status: No biological age. Depicted as an adult-coded projection. Do not redraw her as a child. Appeal is the code pane and the coat, not a transparent body.
characters.memory_point: a vertical pane of scrolling station code standing just behind her shoulder
characters.silhouette_class: tall hair-bell column with a rectangular pane

characters.name: Elara
characters.age_status: Numeric age not locked. Depicted as an adult priestess. Appeal is calm, cloth, and the crescents. Do not turn the vestments into a costume accident.
characters.memory_point: a crescent clasp at the throat and a second crescent on the skirt, both the same silver-green
characters.silhouette_class: wide floor-length bell with a side braid

characters.name: Kira
characters.role: sunfire scout who reads rift weather through ears and tail
characters.age_status: Age not locked. Lore recruits her as a teenager and never states a current adult age. Appeal is ears, tail, and competence. The costume stays fully covering. Do not use the shipped beachwear armor as a reference.
characters.memory_point: cat ears scorched pale at the tips, and a tail that ends in a hard amber light
characters.silhouette_class: compact athletic wedge with ears breaking the outline

main_colour.name: sun amber
main_colour.means: heat she no longer has to hide

characters.name: Nova
characters.role: quiet analyst who hides in an oversized jacket
characters.age_status: Age not locked. Lore has her as a junior researcher in youth. Appeal is the hood, the pane, and the competence of the kit. The jacket is a shield, not a costume slip.
